clientCharacter.y: 郭汜，又名郭多，是凉州张掖人，东汉末年将领、军阀，献帝时权臣。本来为董卓部下。董卓被杀以后，凉州众将归无所依，加上王允对于董卓旧部的态度不明，导致郭汜等人内心惶恐，产生自保念头，想趁机逃跑，然此时，贾诩献策，郭汜等人考量良久后，于是便采用贾诩之谋，联兵将攻向长安，击败吕布，杀死王允等人。 郭汜等人占领长安，把持朝廷大权。这几年之间，李傕[jué]等人相互争权夺利，矛盾越来越激化。后来，郭汜欲劫汉献帝返回长安，计划败露，郭汜弃军逃奔南山。最后，郭汜被部将伍习杀死。

mechanismBoundaries: Same-target bypass must stay exact actor-target through distance, quota, prohibition and multi-target action validation; no global unlimited policy. Unlimited count does not automatically mean an invented refund/no-debit rule.

BorrowedSword primary targets are weapon holders only; implicit-self uses remain self and cannot qualify another actor. Reuse pure target normalization principles from accepted SuFei without modifying its definition or gameplay hash.

Native accepted action ordering is distinct from finalization and completion ordering. A nested second use cannot qualify until both actual uses have completed; one pair creates at most one native optional occurrence, including when that occurrence is declined.

Native Snatch uses a real hand entity, original source/hash/phase/parent context and native actor/provider/material payment; normal distance/prohibition still applies, including Tanbei target prohibition. Old UseSelectedCardsAs does not support Snatch and will not be mislabeled as complete support.
Random hand card identities remain trusted/private until native movement legitimately reveals them. Public new facts must not expose unknown hand IDs.

No character-specific official FAQ was found for empty HEJ, paid pact source loss, nested ordering or multi-owner combinations. The 2018/2019 release pages repeat the printed rule, not combination rulings.

operations.name: ChooseTanbeiTargetPact
operations.contract: Actual own Play activation once per phase, zero materials and exactly one other-living target. That actual target chooses one of the two printed options; no owner answer substitution. Freeze private RNG result/entity/zone and actual move bounds on owning frame, public fact only count/bounds.

operations.name: OfferSidaoCompletedPairSnatch
operations.contract: Optional CardUseCompleted actor-owned trigger, exact actual own Play once. Require two adjacent actual accepted Use actions, both at native completed timing, with the same actual other primary target. Select exactly one legal owner hand material and issue a real native Snatch against that recorded target using ordinary-trick legality and typed native return.

persistentState: Private frozen CharacterState last-two accepted-use ledger sorted by true native ActionId, with finalized primary targets and true completion status updated by exact native identity. Empty/non-other targeting uses interrupt the sequence. Never reorder by nested completion order.

Private immutable CharacterState target pact persists through subsequent source loss until the original actual turn ends; no future grant is issued without the source. Original source/hash/actor/target/turn/phase/native movement/RNG bounds are frozen and proved by the unique scalar public payment fact. Existing DirectedTurnCardPolicy lifetime is unchanged.
Current pair qualification and pending random movement/native Snatch stay on the actual owning CardUse/ProgramSkill frame. No use-ID global sidecar or parallel pending object.
implementationInterpretations: An empty HEJ target may choose the first printed option, obtain zero cards, and still establish the target-specific prohibition; no official combination FAQ was found.
Tanbei unlimited count retains ordinary native debit and only bypasses the quota for the exact consenting target. A paid pact survives skill loss for the rest of its true turn.

Sidao orders genuine accepted Use actions by native ActionId; nested completion never reorders issuance. Completion refreshes actual finalized primary targets after all finalized-window modifications. Empty/self-only uses interrupt eligible other-target continuity.

Native Slash-defense Dodge and real Nullification uses participate as empty-primary uses; Duel/Barbarian Slash and ArrowBarrage Dodge play-out responses do not. Response membership is proved against the actual native parent and typed response-use completion.

One optional pair occurrence is recorded once even when declined; the actual accepted Sidao activation quota is one per real Play phase. Multiple source combinations have no dedicated official FAQ and have not been separately verified.

Paid movement and native Snatch retain original owning-frame invoices through source loss/death. Native Snatch returns to a typed terminal stage before successful binding completion; no fake card or second payment.
